description: This file defines a React functional component 'GuardrailInfoView' that displays and allows editing of guardrail configuration details, including fetching guardrail data, managing form state, and rendering various UI components for overview and admin settings.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailInfo
methods.description: Fetches guardrail details from backend, updates state variables, initializes PII configuration and selections.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailProviderSpecificParams
methods.description: Fetches provider-specific parameters for guardrails from backend.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailUISettings
methods.description: Fetches UI settings related to guardrails.

methods.name: resetToolPermissionEditor
methods.description: Resets the tool permission configuration to initial state based on fetched data.

methods.name: handleToolPermissionConfigChange
methods.description: Handles updates to tool permission configuration.

methods.name: handlePiiActionSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of actions for PII entities.

methods.name: handleGuardrailUpdate
methods.description: Validates and sends updated guardrail data to backend.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Helper to format date strings into a localized string.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies given text to clipboard and shows success feedback.
